#### Attribute details: `thread.id`

Wire key `thread.id`; registry id `openai_codex.thread.id`.

https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.163.0/codex-rs/exec/src/lib.rs#L246

https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.163.0/codex-rs/core/src/tools/parallel.rs#L192

https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.163.0/codex-rs/core/src/session/startup_prewarm.rs#L275

https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.163.0/codex-rs/core/src/tasks/mod.rs#L355

Codex sends this value under the wire key `thread.id`, which the core registry defines as the
integer managed thread id. On the Codex spans that reference it, the key carries the Codex
conversation thread UUID as a string. This is the deep vendor key; its normalized
counterpart is `gen_ai.conversation.id`.

Examples: `["0199a213-81c0-7800-8aa1-bbab2a035a53"]`.

Attribute annotations:

```json
{
  "qyl": {
    "openai": {
      "literal_name": "thread.id"
    }
  }
}
```

## Runtime metrics: filtering and documentation discrepancies

### Metrics excluded from the built-in Statsig route

These names are explicitly filtered for that route. A configured custom OTLP exporter is not subject to this exact-name exclusion list. Their presence in source does not mean OpenAI receives them through the default metrics route.

`codex.api_request`, `codex.api_request.duration_ms`, `codex.conversation.turn.count`, `codex.responses_api_engine_iapi_ttft.duration_ms`, `codex.responses_api_engine_service_tbt.duration_ms`, `codex.responses_api_engine_service_ttft.duration_ms`, `codex.tool.call`, `codex.tool.call.duration_ms`, `codex.turn.cost_microusd`, `codex.turn.token_usage`, `exec_server_client_requests_total`.

[Source: Statsig filter](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.163.0/codex-rs/otel/src/metrics/config.rs).

### Public-documentation names not found in this release inventory

Retained here so they are not silently lost. Absence from the pinned source does not, by itself, establish a formal deprecation. In particular, the current implementation uses `codex.cloud_config_bundle.*` where the public prose lists `codex.cloud_requirements.*`.

| Documented name | Status in this manual |
| --- | --- |
| `codex.cloud_requirements.fetch.duration_ms` | Documentation-only discrepancy; not verified as an emitted 0.163.0 metric |
| `codex.cloud_requirements.fetch_attempt` | Documentation-only discrepancy; not verified as an emitted 0.163.0 metric |
| `codex.cloud_requirements.fetch_final` | Documentation-only discrepancy; not verified as an emitted 0.163.0 metric |
| `codex.cloud_requirements.load` | Documentation-only discrepancy; not verified as an emitted 0.163.0 metric |
| `codex.model_warning` | Documentation-only discrepancy; not verified as an emitted 0.163.0 metric |
| `codex.task.undo` | Documentation-only discrepancy; not verified as an emitted 0.163.0 metric |
| `codex.thread.side` | Documentation-only discrepancy; not verified as an emitted 0.163.0 metric |
| `codex.windows_sandbox.elevated_setup_success` | Documentation-only discrepancy; not verified as an emitted 0.163.0 metric |

[Public configuration/metrics page](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/config-file/config-advanced).


## Additional native attribute names

| Attribute | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `codex.mcp.error.code` | MCP routing/error attribution; not a standalone signal name. |
| `codex.mcp.server_user_flow.triggered` | MCP routing/error attribution; not a standalone signal name. |
| `codex.mcp.target.id` | MCP routing/error attribution; not a standalone signal name. |
| `codex.turn.token_usage.cache_write_input_tokens` | Token-usage value attached to a turn/span; not a standalone metric. |
| `codex.turn.token_usage.cached_input_tokens` | Token-usage value attached to a turn/span; not a standalone metric. |
| `codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens` | Token-usage value attached to a turn/span; not a standalone metric. |
| `codex.turn.token_usage.non_cached_input_tokens` | Token-usage value attached to a turn/span; not a standalone metric. |
| `codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens` | Token-usage value attached to a turn/span; not a standalone metric. |
| `codex.turn.token_usage.reasoning_output_tokens` | Token-usage value attached to a turn/span; not a standalone metric. |
| `codex.turn.token_usage.total_tokens` | Token-usage value attached to a turn/span; not a standalone metric. |
| `codex.usage.reasoning_output_tokens` | Token-usage value attached to a turn/span; not a standalone metric. |
| `codex.usage.total_tokens` | Token-usage value attached to a turn/span; not a standalone metric. |

`record_responses` can set a span’s `otel.name` from response item kind. Source-defined kinds include agent messages, reasoning, function/custom tool calls and outputs, tool-search output, web search, image generation, compaction and configuration/context-compaction items. Unknown/other items remain possible. See [response span recording](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.163.0/codex-rs/otel/src/events/session_telemetry.rs).
